description: This file defines a Room Data Access Object (DAO) interface for accessing full-text search (FTS) entities related to topics within an Android app. It provides methods for inserting topics, searching topics using full-text search, and retrieving the count of topics in the database.

classes.name: TopicFtsDao
classes.description: A DAO interface for TopicFtsEntity providing methods to insert topics, perform full-text search queries, and get the total count of topics.

methods.name: insertAll
methods.description: Inserts a list of TopicFtsEntity objects into the database, replacing on conflict.

methods.name: searchAllTopics
methods.description: Performs a full-text search for topics matching the given query, returning a flow of topic IDs.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns a flow containing the total number of topics stored.
